newsitem.title: USA: NuCo2 to buy CO2 systems in four states.
newsitem.headline: NuCo2 to buy CO2 systems in four states.

text.p: NuCo2 Inc said Monday it will acquire the bulk CO2 systems and bulk CO2 supply operations of a privately owned carbon dioxide distributor operating in the Oklahoma, Kansas, Texas and Arkansas markets.
The acquisition will add about 850 systems and related customer contracts to the company's customer base.

The acquisition adds two states to NuCo2's current service area, Oklahoma and Kansas, and adds to its account base in two others, Texas and Arkansas. The company said it expects to begin service to these accounts on or about May 1.

The company would name the distributor with whom it has made this deal, although a spokesman said it is not the BOC Group. On Friday, NuCo2 said it would acquire that company's retail CO2 fountain beverage assets and customer base in three markets.
NuCo2 supplies bulk C02 systems and liquid carbon dioxide to retail establishments for use in the carbonation and dispensing of fountain beverages.
